kind: new P3 living loop (staged, not registered)
model: kling3_0 pro 16:9, sound off, enhance_prompt false, start_image = end_image = the plate job
prompt: Animate the supplied image with extremely restrained, continuous ambient motion while preserving the exact composition, framing, colours and lighting. Camera locked on a tripod: zero orbit, dolly, pan, zoom, shake or focus pull. The floating candles bob gently and their flames flicker softly; a few castle windows twinkle; a low mist drifts over the black lake, whose surface ripples faintly. The broom stays exactly where it is and does not move; the dark empty sky and lake on the left of the frame stay dark and still. One uninterrupted shot. Every moving element completes exactly one slow, even cycle and eases back to its original shape, so the first and last frames are identical. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker or exposure change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.

prePatch.what: 0-credit broom hold-out: frame 0 (the pinned plate frame) composited over every master frame inside a feathered broom mask before the seam
prePatch.why: raw master broom texture re-renders frame to frame: broom mask max mean|dY| 1.97/255 (handle 2.95 on a thin line mask), broom rects 1.11-1.30/255 on the tool check (1.58-1.68 on full-res), > the 1/255 static limit; phase shift <= 0.58 px, so no positional move, only texture boil (the rock around it boils too: 1.34/255 in a broom-free rect)

mask.excludes: every candle (nearest flame >= 30 px outside the feather)

prePatch.math: yuv420p planes in float, out = src*(1-a) + src[0]*a (chroma with a 2x-downsampled alpha), rounded to 8-bit
prePatch.output: media-src/p3/masters/intro-play-930949e7-broomhold.mkv (FFV1 lossless, 193 f, gitignored); script kept in the session scratchpad (b2chk/py/hold.py), not in the repo
prePatch.effect: broom mask 1.97 -> 0.00/255 on the patched master, 0.037 (mp4) / 0.005 (webm) on the deliverables; broom rects 0.07-0.48/255; Play zone unchanged 0.25/255

l2Sweep: Frames 0/25/50/75/100% (193 f master) + 120% crops of broom, castle and lake, 200% gridded broom crops: no people, riders, figures, faces or hands; no letters, numbers, logos or symbols (castle windows are plain lit rectangles); broom unchanged and unridden; candles keep their shape; no mist wall, no lightning or flash. Plate content only.
motion: Very restrained: whole-frame luma range 0.43-0.67 %; the candles do not visibly bob; candle flames and the lake reflections shimmer faintly (light zones ptp 0.5-1.1 %, 0 reversals/s); max 16x9-tile change vs frame 0 is 1.8/255. Reads as a breathing still. Judge in real time.
visualChecks: Slit-scans across the wrap (loop.mjs frames --slit, +-36 frames) on the MP4 and the WebM show no vertical seam at the wrap; wrap strips (N-2, N-1 | 0, 1) continuous; x8 wrap-diff shows only natural motion detail. Halos (candles, lanterns) at 6x gain: no contour banding in either codec.
flags: 0-credit broom hold-out patch applied (see patch). The broom is pixel-identical to frame 0 in every frame, which also makes the Play -> IN-02 match cut exact.
